record.label: Rescaled baseline and 8.22-fold cost reduction
record.statement: Appendix H.2 rescales the published Toffoli count using a tighter bound on the generalized QSP degree. The resulting baseline costs about $4.98\times10^{15}$ in logical spacetime, giving a reported reduction of $8.22\times$.
record.boundary: The reported ratio divides the rescaled baseline cost by the certified cost bound for the new circuit. The baseline uses $\epsilon_{\mathrm{BE}}=0.01$ on the ancilla-zero block. Appendix H.1 obtains a full-output bound of about $0.041$ for that construction. The new circuit satisfies the full-output bound $\varepsilon=0.01$.
